description: This file contains SQL migration scripts for creating and modifying core tables in a PostgreSQL database for the SpendSense analytics dashboard. It includes table definitions, schema updates, constraints, indexes, triggers, and comments for 'users', 'transactions', and 'alerts' tables that are essential for the application's data model.
calls: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS citext
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_users_set_updated_at ON public.users
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.transactions
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_transactions_user_id
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_transactions_transaction_date_desc
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_transactions_category
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_transactions_merchant
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_transactions_set_updated_at ON public.transactions
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.alerts
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_alerts_user_id
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_alerts_created_at_desc
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_alerts_status
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_alerts_set_updated_at ON public.alerts
